name: baseball-playoffs
description: The MLB postseason tracker page and its live-data connector. No runtime dependencies: plain node for tests and the build, ESLint and Prettier for checks, and Playwright for browser tests.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:browser
scripts.deploy: node worker/build.mjs && npx wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml
